visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a young woman with brown hair tied back, holding a black smartphone horizontally. She has a long biscuit stick in her mouth, mimicking a cigarette or a toothpick while playing. The background is a neutral-colored wall with soft, warm indoor lighting. (2) Scene shifts to a medium shot of the same woman sitting on a gray fabric sofa. She is wearing a light yellow knit top and dark jeans. A studio lamp is visible in the upper right corner, casting a bright glow. She is intensely focused on the phone screen. (3) The visuals transition to screen captures of the mobile game 'Arena of Valor,' showing high-action combat sequences with colorful ability effects and health bars. (4) Back to the woman, she bites into the biscuit stick with a determined look, then holds four sticks between her fingers like claws in a stylized pose. (5) A series of product shots follow, showing various boxes of Glico PRETZ snacks with 'Arena of Valor' character illustrations. The boxes are arranged on a light-colored wooden surface. (6) Close-up of hands scratching an silver scratch-off panel on the back of a snack box and peeling off a double-layered sticker to reveal a code. (7) Graphical overlays display game character skins and in-game currency rewards associated with the snack purchase. (8) The woman reappears, smiling and holding a green PRETZ box and a single stick, speaking directly to the camera in a friendly manner. (9) Final shot of the woman from a low angle as she places another stick in her mouth and continues playing the game, with promotional text overlays appearing at the bottom.

Frequent game SFX like metallic sword slashes and magical impacts are mixed in, synchronized with visual cuts. (3) A distinct, crisp crunch SFX is heard as the person bites a biscuit stick, followed immediately by a comedic 'ding' sound effect. (4) The audio shifts into a more standard promotional narrative style, though the energetic BGM continues at a steady 128 BPM. SFX of paper rustling and a rhythmic 'scratching' sound occur during the product demonstration phase. (5) The narrator's tone rises in valence and arousal during the call-to-action phase. The track concludes with a final synthesized swell and a high-pitched chime as the voice emphasizes the brand name.
